quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to change out of pajamas and into daytime clothes"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: This is when pajamas come off and daytime clothes go on.
quests.explanation: Well done! Getting dressed helps us feel ready for school or play.
quests.funFact: Laying out your clothes the night before can make getting dressed super fast in the morning!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to get snuggly and warm before bed"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: These clothes often have fun patterns like stars or stripes.
quests.explanation: Well done! Putting on pajamas helps us feel snug and ready for bed.
quests.funFact: Many pajamas are covered in fun patterns like stars, stripes, or favorite animals!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to stop dreaming and hop out of bed"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: An alarm clock often helps remind your body it's time for this.
quests.explanation: Well done! Every morning begins the moment we wake up.
quests.funFact: Your body has its own natural clock that helps you wake up at the same time every day!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to close your eyes after a long, fun day"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: A cozy pillow and a warm blanket are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good night's sleep helps us grow strong and feel happy.
quests.funFact: Sleeping at night gives your busy body time to rest and grow strong!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to whisper sweet dreams to your family"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: You say this just before the lights go off.
quests.explanation: Well done! We say good night to the people we love before bedtime.
quests.funFact: Saying good night with a hug or kind words can help you feel calm and happy before sleep!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to feel bright, clean, and ready for the day"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: It helps wake up your sleepy eyes.
quests.explanation: Well done! A splash of cool water is a great way to start the day.
quests.funFact: Cool water on your face can help you feel awake and alert in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to brush away bed head before the day starts"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: It helps you look neat and tidy before school.
quests.explanation: Correct! We comb our hair each morning to get ready for the day.
quests.funFact: Some children like fun hairstyles like braids or ponytails after combing their hair!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to fill your tummy before bedtime gets close"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: This is usually the last meal you eat each day.
quests.explanation: Correct! We gather for dinner in the evening before getting ready for bed.
quests.funFact: Many families enjoy eating dinner together at the very same table each night!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to share a gentle goodbye before the lights go off"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: It's a warm, kind way to end the whole day.
quests.explanation: Correct! Saying good night helps everyone feel cozy before falling asleep.
quests.funFact: Families all around the world have their own special way of saying good night!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to soak in warm water before bedtime"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: This washes away the whole day's dirt in one splash.
quests.explanation: Correct! We take a bath in the evening to get ready for a cozy night's sleep.
quests.funFact: Bath time is a great time to sing a silly song while you splash!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to give your body fuel before school"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: It gives your body energy to run, play, and learn.
quests.explanation: Correct! Eating breakfast gives our body the fuel it needs to start the day.
quests.funFact: Eating a healthy breakfast can help you feel focused during your first class!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to put on your favorite soft sleep shirt"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: You wear these all night until morning comes.
quests.explanation: Correct! We change into pajamas at night, right before we go to sleep.
quests.funFact: Soft, comfy pajamas can help your body feel relaxed and ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to get comfy and drift off to sleep"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: Your eyes get heavy and sleepy right before this happens.
quests.explanation: Correct! We go to bed at night so we can wake up ready for a new day.
quests.funFact: Most children need about ten to twelve hours of sleep every single night!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to rinse away sleepiness before breakfast"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: You gently pat dry with a towel once you finish this.
quests.explanation: Correct! Washing our face is one of the first things we do each morning.
quests.funFact: Washing your face gently helps keep your skin clean and healthy!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to get ready to head out the door"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: You pick a shirt, pants, and maybe a favorite pair of socks.
quests.explanation: Correct! We choose our clothes and get dressed every single morning.
quests.funFact: Many schools have a favorite color or uniform that students wear when they get dressed!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to greet the day with a big stretch and a smile"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: You do this before you even get out of bed.
quests.explanation: Correct! Waking up gets us ready for a whole day of learning and play.
quests.funFact: Getting enough sleep at night helps you wake up feeling happy and ready to play!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning and Night to keep your teeth strong and healthy"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: This keeps your smile sparkly and helps stop tiny tooth troubles.
quests.explanation: Correct! A clean smile starts with brushing our teeth every morning and night.
quests.funFact: Baby teeth need brushing too, even though new teeth will grow in later!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to leave your bed looking neat and tidy"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: Straightening blankets and lining up pillows are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Correct! We make our bed each morning right after we wake up.
quests.funFact: A neatly made bed is extra cozy and inviting when it's time to sleep again!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to get comfy right before story time"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: These clothes are soft, comfy, and just for sleeping.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on pajamas at night to get cozy before bed.
quests.funFact: Many pajamas are covered in fun patterns like stars, stripes, or favorite animals!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to gather around the table and share your day"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: You often sit at a table with your family for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat dinner in the evening to enjoy a warm meal together.
quests.funFact: Sharing a meal together is a lovely time to talk about your favorite part of the day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to tuck in your blankets before breakfast"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: You smooth out sheets and fluff a pillow for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We make our bed in the morning to keep our room tidy.
quests.funFact: Making your bed each morning is a small task that can make your whole room feel tidy!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to make your hair look neat and tidy for photos"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: A small tool with teeth-like edges helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We comb our hair in the morning to look neat and tidy.
quests.funFact: Hair can get tangled while you sleep, so a morning comb helps smooth it out!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning and Night before you say hello or good night"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: You use a small brush and a dab of toothpaste for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We brush our teeth in the morning and at night to stay healthy.
quests.funFact: Dentists say we should brush for about two minutes, the same time as a short song!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to put on something comfy for school or play"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: You do this right after breakfast, before you leave home.
quests.explanation: Yes! We get dressed in the morning before we head out for the day.
quests.funFact: Laying out your clothes the night before can make getting dressed super fast in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Night to rest your body after all your busy play"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: You climb under soft blankets for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We go to bed at night to rest our busy bodies.
quests.funFact: Sleeping at night gives your busy body time to rest and grow strong!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to start the day feeling fresh as can be"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: Cool water and a little soap help with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wash our face in the morning to feel fresh and clean.
quests.funFact: Cool water on your face can help you feel awake and alert in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to end the day with warm, kind words"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: You say this to your family right before you close your eyes.
quests.explanation: Yes! We say good night to share a kind goodbye before we sleep.
quests.funFact: Saying good night with a hug or kind words can help you feel calm and happy before sleep!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to scrub clean from head to toe"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: Warm water, soap, and maybe some bubbles are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We take a bath to wash away the day's dirt and feel clean.
quests.funFact: Warm bath water can help your body relax and feel calm before bedtime!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to sit down and enjoy cereal or eggs"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: This is the very first meal you eat each day.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat breakfast in the morning to get energy for the day.
quests.funFact: Breakfast is often called the most important meal because it fuels your whole morning!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning when your alarm rings and your day begins"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: This is the very first thing you do each morning, right after you stop dreaming.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wake up in the morning to start our fun new day.
quests.funFact: Your body has its own natural clock that helps you wake up at the same time every day!
